title: No Appeal on File

criterion_results.form_integrity: A — the lower records, upper denial, opaque marker, merged state, and manifest-retained layers are an actual OCI image layout rather than illustrative prose.
criterion_results.specificity_density: B+/A- — the file paths, marker, layer order, and exact state transition are load-bearing; the three appeal sentences are intentionally plain but remain generic administrative placeholders.
criterion_results.closure_risk: A- — NO APPEAL ON FILE closes the merged filesystem while the manifest still requires the content-addressed lower layer, leaving the denial materially contradicted by its own retained history.
criterion_results.diction_risk: B+ — the status phrase is institutionally exact and severe, while THIS IS AN APPEAL / THE RECORD IS WRONG / I WAS HERE risk reading as schematic labels.
criterion_results.disclosure_survival: A- — disclosure does not dissolve the event: it reveals that the denial and the erased appeal coexist in one required image graph even though only the denial survives in the merged view.
criterion_results.need_test: A — replacing the OCI stack with a prose account would remove the work’s central contradiction between current filesystem truth and retained content-addressed history.

pairwise_order_swap.reason: D002 replaces one explicitly named deletion with a directory-wide opaque disappearance and installs an official denial that survives the erasure.

D004 remains the tighter page: one field changes classification while nobody leaves. D002 is stronger as an artifact-history contradiction but carries more explanatory surface and generic record language.

strengths: The merged state can honestly report no appeal path while the manifest still requires the lower blob containing all three appeal records.
The opaque marker names none of the erased files individually, matching an institutional disappearance better than D001’s explicit whiteout.
The same upper layer installs the denial before a last-position marker; correct lower-only phase semantics make the contradiction independent of tar order.
The artifact remains inspectable without host extraction, and every descriptor, size, digest, layer, and merged-state assertion is independently checked.
residual_risks: The three lower statements may feel like test-fixture prose rather than a particular human record.
The title and status line may make the mechanism legible too quickly, collapsing the reading into a solved OCI puzzle.
A static reader edition can present verified layers but cannot reproduce the full content-addressed graph interaction on the page.
No disclosed external reader has tested whether the work remains alive after the technical mechanism is explained.
candidate_action: Freeze D002 as the third internal anthology candidate. Preserve every rev0068 draft, packet, metrics, spec, receipt, surface, index, layout, and blob byte. Do not create D003 merely to continue the lineage.

lineage.successor_trigger: A concrete later external-reader failure or project-owner line-level instruction, not internal motion for its own sake.
